title: Gap teaching word cards (from the tracker)
subject: English
source: Seeded from english/y1 lessons 82, 85 (Gap teaching word cards (from the tracker))
intro: To understand how to fix the most common mistakes from the practice check

blocks.title: Sort into: ai or ay / a-e
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: ai or ay, a-e.
blocks.answer: ai or ay: train; stay; paint. a-e: plate; snake; game

cards:
mistake
something we got wrong that
helps us learn

grapheme
the letters that write one
sound

alien word
a pretend word that we read
using our sounds; it has no meaning

vowel digraph
two vowels that make one
sound: ai, ee

split digraph
two letters that work together
with a letter in between: a-e

alternative spelling
a different way to write the
same sound
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.model: I do: find the digraphs first: ch, ai. ch-ai-n, chain. th, or: th-or-n, thorn.
I do: ay says /ai/: s-t-ay, stay. e-e says /ee/: th-/ee/-z, these.

questions.q: underline the digraphs, then read: shark, coin, deep
questions.a: sh, ar; oi; ee. shark, coin, deep
questions.model: I do first: shark: underline sh and ar, then blend sh-ar-k.

questions.q: read the alien words: chorb, dreef, quoil
write a real word and an alien word with the same digraph
read and sort: train, cake, tree, these, boat, home
questions.a: /ai/: train, cake. /ee/: tree, these. /oa/: boat, home.
questions.model: I do first: train has ai, so it goes with /ai/; cake has a-e, also /ai/.

questions.q: read the alien words: preem, toap, smike
write the /ai/ word three ways: tr_n, pl_, g_m_
